description: Return the authenticated Style Swipe deep link (bamf.ai/creators/<author_id>/style-swipe?format=...) where a creator likes or passes real top-performing posts to tune their visual taste, plus likes_by_format, rules_set (brand rules saved) and needs_tuning_formats (formats with fewer than 3 likes). Give the user the url; in Claude Code and the desktop app it opens in the built-in browser. Wait for them to finish before generating. Read-only; it never changes anything.

author_id.description: Creator to tune; defaults to the creator the key is scoped to.

name: bamf.open_style_swipe
